why: Series 'No time, mama'. Rebuilt to eliminate extraneous talking-head interview clips at the end as requested, keeping the visual strictly focused on Natalia's clean workout demonstration and natural voiceover tailored for time-poor women 30+.
rules:
Videos in English. Series (strategy 17.11): Fix this (technique mistake + fix), No time mama (3 moves / 20 min), Coach truth (Natalia's own talk), Strong journey (assistant gets stronger - strength milestones, never kilos), Be honest (relatable gym humour), Myth vs fact. Natalia's own Instagram footage comes first; world viral training footage only as support and only women's strength / gym. Main on-screen people: Natalia and her assistant (a plus-size woman) - always respectful and supportive, never shame about weight, no before/after bodies, no mocking. Audience: women 30+, many mums. Never promise weight loss, kilos, results or health outcomes; no medical or nutrition claims, no diet pills or supplements. Never write the word 'free'. Weeks 1-2 CTA: 'Save this + follow for part 2'. No guide, prices or course dates unless the team adds them. Tone: warm, motivating, real, a coach-mum who tells the truth. Hooks: short, concrete, a mistake / question / number in the first 2 seconds.
- Never use robotic AI voiceover with unnatural pauses between words; use natural pacing or Natalia's real voice notes.

problems: Used forbidden CTA asking for 'GUIDE' instead of 'Save this + follow for part 2' per current rules
Shot at 00:05 has heavy pre-existing text baked into the footage covering the screen
Stock fitness footage used featuring random models instead of prioritizing Natalia and her assistant
qa.fix: Replace the stock footage and text-overlayed clip with original training videos of Natalia, re-record voiceover naturally, and change the CTA to 'Save this + follow for part 2'.
